test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
How many black tables are there?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8445121494dd34eae6dc42ebba7a92c557c3eaec76d2f4a8b3b77e7b8fa74718.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c2cd83fbcc61c45a35e93a82aa780c477e5eff476d3e0e602e041645bb0c1ed.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of black tables".

So, the total number of black tables are = 2 + 4 + 5 + 3 = 14,

Hence, the correct answer is "14".
